title: Onbun app screen
description: ui/screen.json for an Onbun app. Generated from companion/kit.cjs.

title.description: Shown in the app bar on PC and as the default navigation title.

chrome.description: standard keeps Onbun's margins and music volume bar. fullscreen gives the app the whole content area and reaches the bottom edge: a scroll runs under the edge and keeps the margin as space after its last item, and an element that fills the height with a background or gradient extends that background to the edge while its content stays inside the margin. Default standard.

background.description: Screen color. Default black.

accent.description: Selected and highlighted states. Default blue.

state.description: Initial screen variables, read as "$ui.name" and changed with the `set` action.

let.description: Named values worked out from data, e.g. {"unread": {"count": "$messages"}}; read them as "$unread". Sheets and covers can have their own `let`.

bar.description: Floating glass bar: {leading:[…], trailing:[…]}. Use glass buttons, menus and pills.

accessory.description: Shown under the bar, e.g. a search field.

sheets.description: Named sheets: {name: {title, body, detents:["medium","large"]}}. Open with {"sheet":"name"}.

covers.description: Named full-screen pages: {name: {bar, body, background}}. Open with {"cover":"name","params":…}.

refresh.description: How often the phone asks for data: {interval: 1.5, fast: 0.45, fastWhen: "$loading"} in seconds.

timelines.description: Media positions that keep moving between updates: {"main": {"track": "$song.id", "position": "$song.current", "duration": "$song.duration", "playing": "$song.playing"}} (seconds). `scrubber` and `lyrics` follow them.

persist.description: Screen variables this phone remembers between launches, e.g. ["face", "theme"].

backdrop.description: An image (usually album art) whose colors tint the whole screen background.

anyOf.description: Sends a command to your app on the PC: {"command":"open","value":…}. Optional "app" sends it to another app, "result":"name" stores the reply in a screen variable, and "onError" runs an action if it fails (the error message is $error).
Opens a named full-screen page; its bindings can read "$params": {"cover":"post","params":"$post"}.
Closes the sheet or page this action runs in: {"dismiss":true}.
Opens a web page on the phone: {"open":"$post.url"}.
Copies text, or an image given as a data: URL or {"kind":"image","data":…}: {"copy":"$post.url"}.
Reads the phone clipboard into a screen variable as {"kind":"text"|"image","data":…} (images as a PNG data: URL under 2 MB), or null: {"paste":"clip"}. The phone may ask once for permission.
Lets you choose a photo, keeps a copy on this phone and stores its path in a screen variable, for `image`: {"photo":"background","maxSize":1600}. Cancelling stops the list.
Plays a haptic: light, medium, heavy, selection, success, warning, error.
Asks the PC for fresh data now: {"refresh":true}.

stack.description: Lays children out in a column or a row.

when.description: Show the component only when this expression is truthy.

padding.description: Inner spacing: a number for all sides, [vertical, horizontal], or [top, leading, bottom, trailing].

height.description: Fixed height in points, or "screen" for the visible content height (minus `screenOffset`).

screenOffset.description: Points subtracted from the screen height when `height` is "screen". Default 0.

maxWidth.description: Maximum width; the component centers in wider space.

fill.description: Grow to fill the available width, height or both.

align.description: Where content sits inside the frame when it is larger than the content.

background.description: Flat background color. Use `glass` for a floating material instead.

glass.description: The floating material behind the component, in `shape`: Liquid Glass on iPhone, a tonal Material surface on Android. Use it for floating controls only; content stays flat.

glassTint.description: Tint for the glass, e.g. to mark a selected control.

shape.description: Shape for `background`, `glass` and clipping. Default rounded.

corner.description: Corner radius for the rounded shape. Default 24.

foreground.description: Default color for text and symbols inside.

gradient.description: Colors for a diagonal gradient background (top leading to bottom trailing), e.g. ["#0A84FFA6", "black"].

shadow.description: Soft drop shadow with this radius, for artwork that floats.

scale.description: Scale factor; changes animate, e.g. shrink artwork while paused.

action.description: Runs when the component is tapped.

key.description: Stable identity, so animations and state follow the right item.

alignment.description: Cross-axis alignment. Default leading (vertical) or center (horizontal).

layers.description: Stacks children on top of each other (first child at the back).

padding.description: Inner spacing: a number for all sides, [vertical, horizontal], or [top, leading, bottom, trailing].

height.description: Fixed height in points, or "screen" for the visible content height (minus `screenOffset`).

screenOffset.description: Points subtracted from the screen height when `height` is "screen". Default 0.

maxWidth.description: Maximum width; the component centers in wider space.

fill.description: Grow to fill the available width, height or both.

align.description: Where content sits inside the frame when it is larger than the content.

background.description: Flat background color. Use `glass` for a floating material instead.

glass.description: The floating material behind the component, in `shape`: Liquid Glass on iPhone, a tonal Material surface on Android. Use it for floating controls only; content stays flat.

glassTint.description: Tint for the glass, e.g. to mark a selected control.

shape.description: Shape for `background`, `glass` and clipping. Default rounded.

corner.description: Corner radius for the rounded shape. Default 24.

foreground.description: Default color for text and symbols inside.

gradient.description: Colors for a diagonal gradient background (top leading to bottom trailing), e.g. ["#0A84FFA6", "black"].

shadow.description: Soft drop shadow with this radius, for artwork that floats.

scale.description: Scale factor; changes animate, e.g. shrink artwork while paused.

key.description: Stable identity, so animations and state follow the right item.

slider.description: A slider. The action runs when you let go, with the value as `$value`.
